t: This is a statue of Richard Green, in Poplar. Green was a shipowner and philanthropist, born in 1803 and died in 1863. The statue is the work of Edward William Wyon, an English sculptor known for his busts, medals and architectural sculpture. I don't have more detail on why this monument stands here, but a shipowner honoured in stone, in a part of London so tied to the river, tells you something about how his work was regarded.
